basis.governing_question: How should Atlas Logistics design and pilot a digital freight-matching platform for small shippers in Iberia, reaching 200 active shippers on the pilot?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the freight-matching platform blueprint for small Iberian shippers and test its hypotheses with customer evidence.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Does the blueprint justify launching the pilot with real customers?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Launch a first platform version to real small shippers and track progress toward 200 active pilot shippers.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Are the pilot results against the 200-shipper target and the scale-up plan approved?

workstreams.name: Platform hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which hypotheses about shippers, matching and the platform must hold for the blueprint to work?
activities: Frame hypotheses on each blueprint component
Review documents on freight matching for small shippers
Align the hypotheses with the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Small-shipper evidence
workstreams.answers: What do small Iberian shippers and market data show about each blueprint hypothesis?
activities: Interview small shippers on how they book freight today
Analyze operational data on small-shipper freight flows
Assess the Iberian small-shipper market from documents

workstreams.name: Wireframe prototype
workstreams.answers: What matching flow works for small shippers when tested with them as a wireframe prototype?
activities: Draft a wireframe prototype of the matching flow
Test the wireframes with small shippers
Refine the prototype from shipper feedback

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: Which blueprint components hold up against the evidence, and what detailed plan does the pilot need?
activities: Consolidate tested hypotheses into the blueprint
Plan the pilot phase in detail
Prepare the pilot go/no-go material for the gate

workstreams.name: Pilot KPIs and alignment
workstreams.answers: Which KPIs and internal roles do the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales need to run the pilot?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales
Track active pilot shippers against the 200 target
Identify the internal roles the pilot needs to run

workstreams.name: First shipper group
workstreams.answers: Which small shippers should form the first pilot group, and what do they need from the platform?
activities: Interview small shippers who could join the pilot
Analyze operational data to segment candidate shippers
Define the first target group with the Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Platform build and launch
workstreams.answers: How do we build the first platform version and launch it to a small group of real shippers?
activities: Build the first platform version from the blueprint
Prepare the launch readiness review for the first workshop
Launch to the first shipper group and onboard them

workstreams.name: Scale-up business case
workstreams.answers: How did the pilot perform against the 200-shipper target, and what scale-up plan follows?
activities: Compare pilot results against the 200-shipper target
Build the business case from pilot data and interviews
Draft the implementation plan and roadmap for scale-up

deliverables.name: Interim small-shipper evidence on the hypotheses
Small-shipper and market evidence on the hypotheses
Tested wireframe prototype of the matching flow
Pilot go/no-go pack with detailed pilot plan
Agreed pilot KPIs and internal roles for the pilot
Pilot progress report against the 200-shipper target
First pilot shipper group and its platform needs
First platform version and launch readiness review
Live platform with the first shipper group onboarded
Scale-up business case with implementation plan and roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm the scope, team and calendar?
agenda: Present the engagement objectives, phases and meeting calendar
Align on the client roles and the engagement team
Confirm the scope, team and calendar

events.label: Check-in: early evidence
events.decision: Which hypotheses should the blueprint detail first?
agenda: Present the hypotheses and the interim small-shipper evidence
Discuss where the evidence supports or challenges each hypothesis
Decide which hypotheses the blueprint details first

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide whether to launch the pilot
events.decision: Does the blueprint justify launching the pilot with real customers?
agenda: Present the blueprint, tested prototype and detailed pilot plan
Review the small-shipper and market evidence behind the hypotheses
Decide on launching the pilot with real customers

events.label: Check-in: pilot set-up
events.purpose: Check pilot KPIs and first shipper group
events.decision: Is the first shipper group confirmed for onboarding at launch?
agenda: Review the agreed pilot KPIs and internal roles
Present the first shipper group and its platform needs
Confirm the first group for onboarding at launch

events.label: Workshop 1: readiness
events.decision: Is the first platform version cleared to go live with the first shipper group?
agenda: Present the first platform version and launch readiness review
Review pilot KPIs, roles and the first shipper group before launch
Confirm the go-live decision for the first shipper group

events.label: Workshop 2: scale-up case
events.purpose: Review pilot results and scale-up substance
events.decision: Which scale-up options should the business case detail?
agenda: Present the pilot progress report against the 200-shipper target
Review the live platform with the first shipper group onboarded
Discuss scale-up options before the business case is finalized

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve pilot results and scale-up plan
events.decision: Are the pilot results against the 200-shipper target and the scale-up plan approved?
agenda: Present the scale-up business case with implementation plan and roadmap
Review pilot results against the 200-shipper target
Decide on approval of the results and the scale-up plan

architect_notes: The plan rests on an assumed engagement type, inferred from the pilot with real customers; confirm it before this becomes a quote.
The stated 26 weeks are split into 7 for Design and 19 for Pilot, an estimate within the archetype's typical ranges.
The rollout after the pilot is not in these phases, because the client wants a new platform built; confirm no later phase is wanted.
